description: This file contains unit tests for different grain versioning and upgrade strategies in an Orleans-based distributed system. It defines test classes for minimum version activation, latest version activation, compatibility strategies, and randomized version distribution, with each class focusing on specific versioning scenarios.

classes.name: MinimumVersionTests
classes.description: Tests ensuring that v1 grains are activated even with multiple silos when using the MinimumVersion strategy.

classes.name: LatestVersionTests
classes.description: Tests verifying that the latest version is activated with the LatestVersion strategy, including upgrades and proxy calls.

classes.name: AllVersionsCompatibleTests
classes.description: Tests preventing automatic upgrades when all versions are compatible, ensuring existing versions remain active.

classes.name: RandomCompatibleVersionTests
classes.description: Tests distributing grain activations randomly across multiple versions, validating probabilistic distribution.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithMinimumVersion
methods.description: Ensures only v1 grains are activated, even after deploying a v2 silo.

methods.name: AlwaysCreateActivationWithLatestVersion
methods.description: Ensures v2 grains are activated after deploying v2 silo.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests upgrading a grain when there are no pending requests.

methods.name: UpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests upgrading a grain when there is an ongoing request.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Verifies that compatible versions do not trigger automatic upgrades when inactive.

methods.name: DoNotUpgradeProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Verifies that compatible versions do not trigger upgrades during active requests.

methods.name: CreateActivationWithBothVersion
methods.description: Validates probabilistic distribution of grain activations across versions over multiple grains.
